notes.title: World's Worst Handyman HUGE DEMO Update V0.23.0b
notes.content:
[h3]Hey, everyone![/h3]
We've got a BIG update for the World's Worst Handyman [b]demo now live![/b] If you are a Steam Deck user I think you'll really enjoy this one! 🛠️

🚧 [b]World's Worst Handyman - Update v0.23.0b! [/b]🛠️

Doug may still be a disaster, but the game’s looking and running smoother than ever! Here’s what’s new:

✨ Visual & Performance Upgrades
[list]
[*] Fixed HDR issues—especially noticeable on Steam Deck OLED!
[*] Boosted performance across levels (Level 3 got a serious tune-up).
[*] Improved colors, lighting, and character visuals for extra charm.
[*] Save system now runs WAY faster. No more sluggish saves!
[/list]

🎮 New Graphics Options
[olist]
[*] Toggle V-Sync on or off!
[*] Set FPS caps to your liking!
[*] Larger text in many areas for easier reading (perfect for Steam Deck players).
[*] Fonts are now consistent and stylish instead of a mismatched mess.
[/olist]

🔧 Gameplay & Audio Tweaks
[list]
[*] Sprinkled in new minor interactions across levels—see what you can find!
[*] Balanced music & SFX levels for a better listening experience.
[*] Tons of bug fixes—because Doug isn’t the only thing breaking stuff.
[/list]

Give it a whirl and let us know what you think! Thanks for playing and supporting our chaotic handyman adventures. 🚀

If you haven't [b]wishlisted the game[/b] yet, you can do so here. It's a small, free way to help our team out a ton! 👇

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1333930/Worlds_Worst_Handyman/

We're still hard at work on the full version of the game! There are some seriously awesome things in the works, and it's taking all my willpower not to spill the beans. I can’t wait for you to see what we’ve got cooking! 

Thank you all for your support! 🛠️💕

-Baby Lumberjack

notes.title: Important Update: Release Date Change and Sneak Peak
notes.content:
[h3]Hey, everyone![/h3]

I wanted to share an important update about the game's release. After much consideration, I've decided to postpone the launch beyond September. This extra time will allow me to enhance the game further and ensure it delivers the exceptional experience you deserve.

Over the past four years, I've poured my heart into creating something truly special—an experience unlike anything you've played before. I'm incredibly excited about the features and levels we're finalizing, and I can't wait for you to explore them.

In the meantime, if you haven't tried it yet, please check out the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1942320/Worlds_Worst_Handyman_Demo/]updated demo[/url] that's available now! It features a completely revamped animal shelter and other exciting enhancements. Your feedback is invaluable and helps make the final game even better.

While I don't have a new release date to announce just yet, please know that I'm working diligently to bring the game to you as soon as it's ready. Your support and patience mean the world to me.

As a token of appreciation, here's a sneak peek at one of the new levels I've been working on! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38131795/ffd7ea847573593b0f11aeb3a6795f303daaf62b.png[/img]

Thank you for being part of this journey. Stay tuned for more updates, and I look forward to sharing the game with you soon!

-Baby Lumberjack

notes.title: World's Worst Handyman Demo V0.21.1b Update
notes.content:
[h3]Hey, everyone![/h3]
Hope you all have been enjoying the new demo! I've been getting some great feedback through the in-game [url=https://forms.gle/BPwY9Uq9W2bP9txM6]feedback survey[/url] and on the [url=https://discord.gg/bWTemY6kEC]official Discord[/url].

If you haven't [b]wishlisted the game[/b] yet, you can do so here. It's a small, free way to help our team out a ton! 👇

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1333930/Worlds_Worst_Handyman/

[h2][b]V0.21.1b for the Demo is now live.  Here are the latest updates:[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]Bird Eye Toggle Update[/b][/h3]
Previously, you could only toggle the bird eye view when the player was completely stopped. Now, you can toggle the bird eye view while moving! It lasts for a short time if you're on the move but stays active if you stop moving until you either move again or toggle it off. There is a small cooldown if you repeatedly toggle the bird eye view while moving. We hope this small change makes the bird eye view more useful while navigating the map.

[h3][b]Job Board Photo Selection[/b][/h3]
Before, shaking a Polaroid picture for a level would only reveal the level, requiring you to press again to enter. This felt a bit unnecessary and confusing for some players. Now, once you shake the photo, it reveals the level and automatically selects it, allowing you to jump right in!

[h3][b]New Pet Photos[/b][/h3]
We've received lots of amazing pet photo submissions on the official Discord. This update includes all of them! Each time you visit the shelter in-game, be sure to check out the pet board to see the new photos. The game randomly selects 10 photos from a big list each time you visit the shelter.

Want to see your pet in the game? Join our [url=https://discord.gg/bWTemY6kEC]official Discord[/url] and submit your pet pictures in the pet-pictures channel. Check the FAQ or pinned comment for specific details.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38131795/bb9e8951148d4c7e39c3000fb3e68dc2174f2c3a.png[/img]

Several other bug fixes have been included as well.

Hope you all enjoy the latest demo!  If you have any other feedback or suggestions you can submit them on the [url=https://discord.gg/bWTemY6kEC]discord [/url]or leave anonymous feedback here on the [url=https://forms.gle/BPwY9Uq9W2bP9txM6]short survey[/url].

Thank you all for your support! 🛠️💕

-Baby Lumberjack

notes.title: Get Ready for DIY Disasters! Demo Now Live!
notes.content:
🔨🔧 GET READY TO FIX IT... OR NOT! 🔧🔨

We are super excited to announce that the World's Worst Handyman Demo is NOW LIVE on Steam!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38131795/d59c3e1bc262221012339514835fe5093c87aa47.gif[/img]

For those of you just tuning in, World's Worst Handyman is a stealth comedy game where you play as Doug, a newbie handyman with a heart of gold and, well, not-so-golden skills. Help him save a local animal shelter from bankruptcy by tackling a series of hilarious odd jobs. Be prepared for a world of quirky characters, thrilling chases, and so many unexpected surprises! 🐾🔧

What's in store for you in the demo, you ask? Here’s the hot list:

[list]
[*]Doug's got a fresh new look! Who knew a handyman could clean up so well? 😎
[*]Meet Ashley, our delightful new NPC holding the fort at the animal shelter! 🐶
[*]A revamped intro cutscene that's so good, you won't dare to blink! 🎬
[*]A visual overhaul so stunning, your jaw will hit the floor! 😍
[*]Rescue stray animals and pet baby penguins 🐧
[*]Fresh new tunes to bob your head to as Doug tries (and often fails) to fix things! 🎶
[*]And a ton of surprises we’re keeping hidden... for now! 😉
[/list]

If the demo tickles your funny bone, please [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1333930/Worlds_Worst_Handyman/]wishlist and follow us on Steam[/url]. Your support means the world to our small team and helps us spread the word!

We can't wait for you to dive into the chaos of World's Worst Handyman!

Till then, keep your hammers high and your duct tape handy,

Yours in DIY disasters,
Baby Lumberjack 🪵
